Detailed Description

NL80211 client implementation.

This class implements the NL80211 client interface. Communication with the WiFi driver is performed with a NL80211 socket injected in the class constructor.

Both the DWPAL and the NL80211 flavors of the BWL library use this implementation to send standard NL80211 commands to the WiFi driver.

Gets radio information.

Radio information contains HT/VHT capabilities and the list of supported channels.

Parameters
[in]interface_nameInterface name, either radio or Virtual AP (VAP).
[out]radio_infoRadio information.
Returns
True on success and false otherwise.

check whether the 80_plus_80 and 160 mhz are supported. if both are supported set 8th and 9th bit. if only 160 supported set 8th.

check whether UL_MU_MIMO and UL_MU_MIMO plus OFDMA are supported.

NO_20MHZ will only be set for channels that are limited to 5 or 10MHz, which is probably not something we will ever want to use. So we can safely skip a channel that has NO_20MHZ set.

NL80211_FREQUENCY_ATTR_NO_IR superseded NL80211_FREQUENCY_ATTR_NO_IBSS for legacy kernels we still need to check __NL80211_FREQUENCY_ATTR_NO_IBSS, for both attributes we use the no_ir.
